entries.mitigation: Assign two players per cleanse pad and do not waste pads by cleansing early or wandering across other assignments.
Hold your assigned position and place pillars cleanly; unnecessary movement spreads curses and consumes safe room space.
Stay with your same-color team, never touch opposite-color players, and attack the opposite-color boss for full damage.

entries.entry_name: Tank Boss Swap — S'kinrai and Vashai
entries.mitigation: Tanks swap bosses on the color cycle so each team continues attacking the opposite-color target.
Interrupt S'kinrai immediately when the beam pins the tank.
Vashai tank baits negates along the wall and moves the boss out of each bubble without dragging it through the team.
Main tank blocks with focused healing and keeps Rakkhat faced away from the group.
Block the jump. Getting launched into a blue pad or a cleanse pad is the expensive version of learning this mechanic.
